info.name: Auth System API v1
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for testing all Auth System API endpoints.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT Bearer authentication. Use the Login endpoint first to obtain tokens.

## Variables
- `baseUrl`: API base URL (default: http://localhost:5000)
- `accessToken`: JWT access token (auto-set after login)
- `refreshToken`: Refresh token (auto-set after login)
- `userId`: Current user ID (auto-set after login)

## Argon2id Hashing
All secrets, tokens, and API keys are hashed using Argon2id algorithm.

Registers a new user account with email and password. Optionally creates a personal organization when createOrganization is set to true (default: false). Sends a verification email - user must verify before they can login.

Returns: userId, maskedEmail, organizationCreated, and a message about next steps.

Authenticates a user via an external provider (e.g., Google). Send the provider's ID token obtained from the frontend SDK. If the user doesn't exist, a new account is created (with email auto-verified). If they do exist, they are logged in. Optionally creates a personal organization when createOrganization is set to true (default: false).

To test: obtain a Google ID token from Google Sign-In JS SDK or OAuth Playground, paste it in the idToken field.
